# Card

**Figma:** Card (page 6643:49849)  
**Import:** `import { Card } from "@zen-ds/react";`

A surface that groups related content about one subject — a project, a stat, a choice — and can be selected or opened as a whole.

## Use it for
- Grids of objects users scan and pick (projects, templates, plans).
- KPI / stat tiles (theme="default", the Surface alone, with nothing else deciding; Shadow beside a shadowed Sidebar).
- A selectable option with rich content (Active marks the choice).
- Framing a List or a group of settings (Border).
- A dashboard widget in colour: Subtle on the grey Canvas/Default, Pale on a white page, in any of the nine hues; or the one widget of a row that stands out (Solid).

## Use something else for
- Page sections that are just spacing → layout, not a card.
- A single line of content → ListItem.
- Rows of comparable data → Table.
- Messages → Inline Message.
- Darkening one card with a mode switch (data-theme) → theme="solid" color="neutral".

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Theme | `theme` | shadow (default) · default (the Surface alone: no border, no shadow; `flat` until 2026-10-21) · border · flat-border (Surface/Flat inside a Border/Neutral/Pale frame: the card of a Canvas/Flat page) · pale (colour on a white page: Canvas/Alt, Canvas/Flat) · subtle (colour on the grey Canvas/Default, Support/<Color>/Subtle; harness card/pale-on-canvas-default) · on-container (Surface/Flat, inside a Dialog, ModalForm, SidePanel or BottomSheet) · solid (the one widget of a row that stands out); semi-pale is deprecated and renders as pale |
| Color | `color` | neutral (default) · brand · cyan · violet · green · yellow · orange · blue · purple · accent, for pale and subtle (Support/<Color>/Pale or /Subtle, the nine hues; a Pale or Subtle accent renders as Neutral) and solid (neutral: Background/Neutral/Solid with Content/Inverse/* content; brand · cyan · orange: Support/<Color>/Solid with Content/On-Colors; yellow: with Content/On-Brights; accent: Background/Accent/Solid with Content/On-Accent; violet, green, blue and purple render as Solid Neutral, harness card/solid-color). Shadow, Default, Border, Flat-Border and On-Container ignore it (harness card/color-ignored). MetricCard and ChartCard pass it to their Card |
| Surface | `surface` | default · alt — Figma Surface per theme: alt on Default and Border (Shadow on alt draws as Default on Surface/Alt); Pale, Subtle, Flat-Border, On-Container and Solid keep their own fill (harness card/surface-ignored). A card on a Canvas/Flat page is theme="flat-border" (surface="flat" is gone). On a Canvas/Alt page pass alt explicitly (only an explicit alt drops the Shadow theme's shadow); unset follows an inherited --zen-card-surface, else default. ChartCard passes it to its Card |
| Spacing | `spacing` | medium (default: Card-padding-medium, Radius 2XLarge) · small (Card-padding-small, Radius Large) · xsmall (Card-padding-xsmall 8, Radius Base 12: compact tiles, e.g. a row of choices on a phone): on a phone, small once three or more cards sit side by side and medium for one or two; desktop cards keep medium (harness card/spacing-by-count) |
| Active | `selected` | Surface + 2px Card/Border/Active (active is the deprecated alias) |
| Clickable | `onClick · aria-label` | role=button, Enter/Space; Border steps up to Neutral/Subtle |
| Sub-Action | `subAction` | { label, icon, onClick } or a node — Small Flat Secondary ⋮ (icon-dots-vertical-line) over the top-right corner; the content keeps the full width |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/card.json`.

### Card
Figma Card (6643:51021): a Content slot on one of six themes (Pale and Solid in a Color), padded Card-padding-medium/small. A clickable card is an actionable container: Border theme steps its stroke up to Border/Neutral/Subtle (§6).

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, "children" | "onClick" | "color">, LayoutWidthProps, LayoutCellProps`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | `"hug" \| "fill" \| number` | — | Horizontal resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual width. `"hug"` (Hug contents): as wide as its content, never grows or stretches. `"fill"` (Fill container): in a row Stack it takes an equal share of the space left after each child's padding and may shrink to 0; in a column Stack it stretches across; in a Grid cell or a plain block it takes the full width. Fill children in a wrapping row need a `minWidth` to wrap. A number: Fixed width in px, which never shrinks in a flex row. Sizes include padding and border (border-box). (Container's `maxWidth` is a different prop: a token width, sm…full.) Prefer hug or fill; use Fixed only for widths that really are fixed (a side column, a preview frame). |
| `minWidth` | `number` | — | Minimum width in px (Figma min width). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0. |
| `maxWidth` | `number` | — | Maximum width in px (Figma max width), e.g. a readable line length for a Fill block of text. |
| `alignSelf` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end" \| "stretch"` | — | This element's alignment inside its parent: start · center · end · stretch across a Stack's direction (vertical in a row, horizontal in a column), vertical inside a Grid cell. Overrides the parent's `align` for this child. A `"fill"` size on the same axis still fills; in a column, alignSelf then places it once maxWidth stops it. No effect outside a Stack or Grid. |
| `span` | `Responsive<number \| "full">` | — | How many of the parent Grid's columns this child takes (Figma Grid auto layout › column span): a whole number, or `"full"` for the whole row. Per breakpoint too, as the Grid's `columns`: `{ desktop: 8, tablet: "full" }` (a breakpoint without its own value takes the next wider one's). Never more than the Grid's columns; every cell takes the whole row while the Grid stacks (`stackBelow`, one column). In a Grid without `columns` (auto-fill) only `"full"` applies. Default 1. No effect outside a Grid. |
| `rowSpan` | `Responsive<number>` | — | How many rows this child takes in the parent Grid (Figma Grid auto layout › row span): a list beside two stacked charts. Per breakpoint too; dropped while the Grid stacks. Default 1. No effect outside a Grid. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLElement>` | — | The root element. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `theme` | `"shadow" \| "default" \| "pale" \| "border" \| "flat-border" \| "on-container" \| "solid" \| "subtle" \| "semi-pale"` | `"shadow"` | Figma Theme: Shadow (Shadow/Bottom/Level-1) · Default (the Surface fill alone: no border, no shadow) · Pale (Support/`<Color>`/Pale + Effect/Overlay blur) · Border (Border/Neutral/Pale) · Flat-Border (15530:502–520: Surface/Flat inside a Border/Neutral/Pale frame, the card of a Canvas/Flat page) · On-Container (Surface/Flat: a card inside a Modal, Side Panel or Bottom Sheet, on their Container fill; harness card/on-container-in-overlay) · Solid (15480:87472: the one widget of a row that stands out; Neutral fills Background/Neutral/Solid/Default and its content reads Content/Inverse/*, a hue fills Support/`<Color>`/Solid) · Subtle (16195:138560…: Support/`<Color>`/Subtle + Effect/Overlay blur, the colour box on a Canvas/Default page, where Pale fades into the grey; Pale is for white pages — user rule 2026-10-17, harness card/pale-on-canvas-default). `semi-pale` is deprecated (no gradients in Figma since 2026-10-14) and renders as pale. |
| `color` | `"neutral" \| "brand" \| "cyan" \| "violet" \| "green" \| "yellow" \| "orange" \| "blue" \| "purple" \| "accent"` | `"neutral"` | Figma Color, for theme="pale" (Support/`<Color>`/Pale, the nine hues: 15480:87358…, 15530:526, 15530:550), theme="subtle" (Support/`<Color>`/Subtle, the same nine hues: 16195:138578…138668) and theme="solid" (neutral: Background/Neutral/Solid/Default; brand · cyan · yellow · orange: Support/`<Color>`/Solid; accent: Background/Accent/Solid/Default, Solid only; Figma has no Solid violet, green, blue or purple and no Pale or Subtle accent, which render as Solid / Pale / Subtle Neutral — harness card/solid-color). Shadow, Default, Border, Flat-Border and On-Container ignore it (harness card/color-ignored). A Solid card re-points the neutral tokens its children read to the fill's own family (Neutral → Content/Inverse/*, Border/Inverse, Background/Inverse/*; Accent → Content/On-Accent; Yellow → Content/On-Brights; the other hues → Content/On-Colors) and tells its Metric parts which family to draw; the page keeps its mode. |
| `spacing` | `"md" \| "sm" \| "xs" \| "medium" \| "small" \| "xsmall"` | `"md"` | Figma Spacing: Medium (Card-padding-medium, Corner-Radius/2XLarge) · Small (Card-padding-small, Corner-Radius/Large) · XSmall (Card-padding-xsmall 8, Corner-Radius/Base 12: a compact tile, such as a row of choices on a phone; the user, 2026-10-20). Short (xs, sm, md) or Figma (xsmall, small, medium) spelling. |
| `selected` | `boolean` | — | Figma Active=Yes: the selected card — Surface fill with a 2px Card/Border/Active stroke. |
| `active` | `boolean` | — | **Deprecated:** Use selected. Figma Active=Yes (the selected card). |
| `surface` | `"default" \| "alt"` | — | Figma Surface, chosen to suit the page's Canvas: Surface/Default · Surface/Alt (Default and Border: 15530:454–496). Unset follows an inherited --zen-card-surface (a page scope can set it once), else Surface/Default. Pale / Flat-Border / On-Container / Solid / Subtle keep their own fill (harness card/surface-ignored). With theme="shadow", `alt` drops the drop shadow (Surface-Alt never casts one, §9) and the card renders as Figma Theme=Default (6643:51018) on Surface/Alt. A page scope that sets an alt --zen-card-surface sets `--zen-card-shadow: 0 0 transparent` with it, so its Shadow cards drop the shadow too; `surface="default"` on a card brings it back. |
| `onClick` | `(event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement> \| KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` | — | Makes the whole card one action (role=button, Enter/Space). Keep other controls out of clickable cards. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — | Accessible name for a clickable card when its content does not start with a clear title. |
| `subAction` | `CardSubAction \| ReactNode` | — | Figma Sub-Action: an absolute layer over the top-right corner holding Button/Icon-Flat Small Secondary (default ⋮). It takes no room: the Content slot keeps the full width. A node (e.g. a Menu) should use the same trigger. |
| `as` | `"div" \| "article" \| "section" \| "li"` | `"div"` |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |
| `overrides` | `Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>>` | — | Figma instance overrides: props of the Zen components the card draws itself, by layer (`{ "Sub-Action": { level: "primary" } }`, `"Sub-Action/Leading-Icon"` one level deeper). Written by Zen Studio; app code sets `subAction`. |

### Types
Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
interface CardSubAction { label: string; icon?: IconName | ReactElement; onClick?: () => void; }
type Responsive<T> = T | { desktop?: T; tablet?: T; mobile?: T }
```

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Enter / Space | Open a clickable card |
| Tab | Reach the Sub-Action |

## ✅ Do
- On a phone, count the cards in the group: three or more side by side (a row of stats, a grid of projects, a list of choices) take spacing="small"; one or two cards, such as a single box around a list, keep Spacing=Medium, the default (harness card/spacing-by-count). A card around a Voice frame stays Small: the frame pads itself (Spacing/Padding/XLarge). Desktop cards keep Medium whatever their number.
- Use one theme per grid. With nothing else deciding (examples, a page with no Sidebar), theme="default" on Canvas/Default: no border, no shadow (usage rules §16). On a Canvas/Flat page, Flat-Border: Surface/Flat inside a Pale frame. Shadow when the screen's Sidebar casts one, Border on a white page, inside another surface or on a clickable card, On-Container inside a Dialog, ModalForm, SidePanel or BottomSheet (on their Container fill; harness card/on-container-in-overlay), Pale on imagery. No gradient box: theme="semi-pale" is a deprecated alias of pale (harness theme/box-on-canvas).
- Match the screen's elevation to its Sidebar: the default Sidebar (Surface + shadow) on the grey Canvas takes Shadow cards with no border; a white Canvas takes a Sidebar on the canvas (shadow={false}, optionally with divider) and Border cards. Never a shadowed Sidebar on a white Canvas, and on the grey Canvas every box casts the shadow or none does (harness theme/mixed-elevation).
- Title a widget card with Heading/Subheading (heading level from the outline); page sections outside cards use Heading/4.
- Make the whole card clickable when it opens one thing, and name it with aria-label when the content doesn't start with a title.
- Use Active for the selected card in a single-choice grid, together with aria-pressed or a radio inside.
- Put secondary card actions in the Sub-Action menu.
- Card shadow = Box effectStyle="Shadow/Bottom/Level-1": a static elevated panel may be a Box with that style; a clickable or selectable panel is a Card.
- Pick surface from the page Canvas: default on Canvas/Default, surface="alt" passed explicitly on a white Canvas/Alt page, theme="flat-border" on a Canvas/Flat page. An explicit alt drops the Shadow theme's shadow; a page scope that sets an alt --zen-card-surface sets --zen-card-shadow: 0 0 transparent with it, so its Shadow cards drop it too.
- Put colour on a box by the page's Canvas: theme="subtle" and a color on the grey Canvas/Default (Pale fades into it), theme="pale" on a white Canvas/Alt or Canvas/Flat page (any of the nine hues, content stays neutral), e.g. a card per project or client (harness card/pale-on-canvas-default).
- Let at most one widget per row stand out with theme="solid"; the dark widget is Solid Neutral, a hue (brand, cyan, yellow, orange) or accent suits one time-sensitive figure.
- Write a Solid card's content as on any card: Text, Heading, Icon, charts, ProgressBar and the ⋮ read the fill's own family by themselves (content follows the fill, user 2026-10-17): Content/Inverse/* on Neutral, Content/On-Colors on Brand, Cyan and Orange, Content/On-Brights on Yellow, Content/On-Accent on Accent. MetricTrend and a MetricCard tile's Dock-Icon follow too (Inverse on Neutral, On-Color on the others). Pick Button appearance="overlay" level="inverse" on Solid Neutral, a Primary button on a Solid hue (Figma Metric-Card Hero), and a Badge or DockIcon theme="inverse" on Solid Neutral, theme="on-color" on Accent and the hues; keep text in a neutral tone (or the family's own), never a colour tone (harness theme/on-solid-content).
- On Brand, Cyan, Orange and Accent the white On-Colors text measures about 3:1: keep what you write there short and large (the number, a title), and put long or small text on another card.
- Pricing plans: Default cards in an auto-fit grid; Active marks the current plan, an Accent Badge marks the recommended one, and each card ends with one md CTA pinned to the bottom whose label says what happens (Upgrade to Pro · Switch · Manage plan).

## ❌ Don't
- Don't put buttons, links or inputs inside a clickable card (harness: card/clickable-no-nested-controls).
- Don't nest cards inside cards.
- On a phone, don't leave three or more cards at Medium, or shrink a card on its own to Small.
- Don't frame a static card with Subtle — Border uses Pale until the card is clickable (§6).
- Don't put a Pale card on the grey Canvas/Default: it fades into the page; use theme="subtle" (harness card/pale-on-canvas-default).
- Don't use Active as decoration; it means selected.
- Don't make a whole row Solid: one widget stands out, the rest share the row's theme.
- Don't set data-theme or a dark mode on one card to darken it: one page is one mode, and theme="solid" color="neutral" re-points only its content tokens.
- Don't put fields, Search or other Surface controls on a Solid card; they keep the page's Surface fill.

## Accessibility
- Clickable cards are one focusable role=button with a visible focus ring; static cards are plain containers.
- Keep reading order: title first, then meta.
- Solid and Pale colours keep AA text contrast in light and dark: Strongest and Base text measure at least 4.5:1 on every Solid fill (a hue Solid reads Light as Base), and Pale and Subtle tints keep Content/Neutral.

## Content
- Title first, then one line of meta.
- Title a card with a Heading one level below the nearest heading above it (h3 under a section h2; h2 when the card sits right under the page title), always textStyle="Heading/Subheading": the style follows the kind of content, not the level.

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `card/clickable-no-nested-controls` | error | A clickable Card (onClick) is one button: it must not contain buttons, links, inputs or a subAction. | `zen-allow-card-nested-control: <reason>` |
| `card/on-container-in-overlay` | warn | A Card right inside a Dialog, ModalForm, SidePanel or BottomSheet takes theme="on-container": Surface/Flat on their Container fill (usage rules §16, user rule 2026-10-12). | `zen-allow-overlay-theme: <reason>` |
| `card/color-ignored` | warn | Card color is the Figma Color of theme="pale" and theme="subtle" (nine hues) and theme="solid"; Shadow, Default, Border, Flat-Border and On-Container have no Color and ignore it. | `zen-allow-card-color: <reason>` |
| `card/surface-ignored` | warn | Figma Card Surface per theme: alt on Default and Border (Shadow on alt renders as Default); Pale, Subtle, Flat-Border, On-Container and Solid keep their own fill. A card on a Canvas/Flat page is theme="flat-border". | `zen-allow-card-surface: <reason>` |
| `card/solid-color` | error | Figma draws Theme=Solid in Neutral, Brand, Cyan, Yellow, Orange and Accent only; other hues render as Solid Neutral (they would fail contrast). Accent is Solid only: a Pale accent renders as Pale Neutral. | `zen-allow-card-color: <reason>` |
| `card/pale-on-canvas-default` | error | On a Canvas/Default page (the grey canvas: AppShell and PlatformPhone unless their canvas says otherwise, a painting ZenProvider) a colour box is theme="subtle" (Support/<Color>/Subtle): Pale fades into the grey. Pale is for white pages (Canvas/Alt, Canvas/Flat, a Surface screen) and imagery (user rule 2026-10-17). | `zen-allow-card-pale-canvas: <reason>` |
| `theme/box-on-canvas` | error | A box (Card, ListBox, MetricCard, ChartCard) draws the Surface of the page's Canvas (Figma audit theme/box-on-canvas, screen-rules §1): Canvas/Default → Default, Shadow or Border (colour: Subtle); Canvas/Alt → Border, Pale, or Default on surface="alt"; Canvas/Flat → Flat-Border or Pale. No gradient box (semi-pale, user 2026-10-14). Solid, and Subtle on a white page, are the stand-out box and fit any canvas. | `zen-allow-box-on-canvas: <reason>` |
| `theme/mixed-elevation` | error | One elevation per page (Figma audit theme/mixed-elevation): nothing casts a shadow on a Canvas/Alt or Canvas/Flat page; on Canvas/Default every box and the Sidebar panel cast Shadow/Bottom/Level-1, or none does. Solid (the stand-out, which has no shadow variant) is not counted. | `zen-allow-mixed-elevation: <reason>` |
| `theme/mixed-boxes` | warn | One box family per page (Figma audit theme/mixed-boxes): Default (with or without Shadow), Border, Flat-Border, Pale or Subtle; vary the Color inside Pale or Subtle instead. A Solid box, and Subtle on a white page, stand out and are not counted. | `zen-allow-mixed-boxes: <reason>` |
| `theme/on-solid-content` | error | Content on a Card theme="solid" takes the fill's family (Figma audit theme/on-solid-content): on Neutral/Solid a Badge or DockIcon is theme="inverse", on Accent and the colour solids theme="on-color"; text and icons keep a neutral tone (the card re-points it to Inverse, On-Accent, On-Brights or On-Colors) or that family's own tone, never a colour tone. | `zen-allow-on-solid-content: <reason>` |
| `card/spacing-by-count` | warn | On a phone (a PlatformPhone frame or a BottomSheet), three or more cards side by side (a row or grid of stats, a list of choices) take spacing="small" (Card-padding-small, Corner-Radius/Large); one or two keep Spacing=Medium, the default. Desktop cards keep Medium and are not judged. MetricCard counts as a card (type="tile" is Small by default). User rule 2026-10-17, mobile only. | `zen-allow-card-spacing: <reason>` |
| `listbox/grouped-on-phone` | error | On a phone settings or profile screen, each group of rows is its own inset <ListBox> block with its kicker (Body/Small/Bold) above it, on a Surface-Alt screen: never several kicker groups in one block, nor bare Lists under kickers straight on the screen (usage rules §15). | `zen-allow-grouped-list: <reason>` |
| `api/deprecated-prop` | warn | A deprecated prop still works but has a canonical name (onValueChange, onCheckedChange, checked, selected, level…); apps get a warning with the replacement. (App mode only; the repo migrates gradually.) | `zen-allow-deprecated: <reason>` |
| `api/overrides-studio-only` | error | `overrides` (Figma instance overrides of the layers a component draws itself: `{ "Sub-Action": { level: "danger" } }`) is written by Zen Studio on the pages it makes; hand-written code sets the component's own props or composes the parts (the user's call, 2026-10-10). | `zen-allow-overrides: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
| `interaction/action-without-handler` | warn | Screens, examples and templates (apps too since 2026-10-07; component source is skipped): every action does something when pressed. Flags a `Button` or `<button>` without onClick / href / type="submit" (IconButton: icon-button/needs-action), an action object ({ icon, label }) in leading, trailing, action, primaryAction, secondaryAction, subAction or actions without onClick, and pressable items whose list has no onSelect / onNavigate / onItemClick / onValueChange. Documented defaults pass: Dialog, ModalForm, SidePanel and BottomSheet actions close the overlay; a Menu opens from its trigger. Apps are not judged. | `zen-allow-action-handler: <reason>` |
